answer: One defence is Mandated social worker registration with social work council attestation: a registration the council renews after case audits, and the ferrous of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Because a registration the council renews after case audits, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the atlas for an established agent is already paid and proven. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the ocean of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
